issues.title: Ingest Crittenden County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $33,095,161 across 23 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($14,523,637), County Jail ($9,718,136), County Road ($3,590,788). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Get the adopted 2026 appropriation ordinance
issues.detail: The book is titled “Approved Budget 2026,” but its only 2026 column is headed “Amount Requested 2026.” Ask the county clerk for the ordinance the quorum court adopted, and check these amounts against it.
